gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kharoshthi: Noto Sans Kharoshthi reads approachable and contemporary, with curves that stay open and a dense, dark band of lowercase in every line. Vast Shadow keeps a level, single-width beat above it, so a long stretch of text feels sturdy rather than fussy.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Clean, modern letters come from Noto Sans Khmer, its small forms standing nearly as tall as capitals. And Vast Shadow's vintage, single-width lettering is what grabs the eye first, with the body quietly doing the rest.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Vintage glass-tube lettering, bent and glowing. Noto Sans Khojki follows with wide exits and a large eye on every e, so the text under Vast Shadow lets light straight through.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi is clean and friendly, with rounds left unlatched. Vast Shadow brings a thin, pipe-cleaner joinery and vintage flair, and the two feel clearly different in weight and temperament.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-kr: Noto Sans KR has generous gaps in its curves and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height. Make Vast Shadow small and it loses its bent-straw charm.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-lao: Vast Shadow draws every letter as a single neon-tube track, vintage and eye-catching. Noto Sans Lao brings a lofty x-height and open mouths, so give the heading plenty of size and let the body stay modest.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Professional and modern, Noto Sans Lao Looped forms its words as solid blocks. Over a long passage its bowls, left open on one side, keep the eye moving smoothly under Vast Shadow's ruler-straight lines.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Vast Shadow looks stencil-cut, every stroke one weight and a vintage swagger throughout. And Noto Sans Lepcha reads approachably over a long passage, its wide-open curves and cast-iron stature of lowercase carrying the text.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Vast Shadow looks traced with a single marker, vintage and made to turn heads. Noto Sans Limbu then reads in a friendly way across a longer passage, its gaping curves and tall small letters easy on the eye.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-noto-sans-lisu: Pencil-sketched, vintage and loud, Vast Shadow never presses harder on any line. But Noto Sans Lisu is the one that carries the reading, with tiny gaps below its ascenders and wide s curves.
